item.title: ‘It's really fun to just be closer to God’: Ash Wednesday marking the start of the Lenten season
item.description: Christians observing Ash Wednesday, a solemn day of fasting and reflection and the start of 40 days of the Lenten season leading up to Easter.

item.title: Williamsville nursing home faces $1.3M lawsuit amid ongoing concerns
item.description: A Williamsville nursing home that has recently faced concerns from family members and employees over building conditions is now at the center of a $1.3 million lawsuit.

item.title: Study recommends new hotel in Buffalo as shortage costs millions in lost business
item.description: A new market analysis recommends Buffalo add a new full-service downtown "headquarters" style property to better position the city as a destination for meetings and conventions.

item.title: 'We never shut them down': Canal Fest relocation sparks questions from city mayors and local church
item.description: This July, Canal Fest will move north to Gratwick-Riverside Park. The decision to move out of the Erie Canal area has left many residents and businesses confused and worried about the change.
